data.one_liner: An extension of Flutter's official Text widget for special inline content and custom overflow.
data.what_it_does: ExtendedText builds special text features quickly like inline images, mentions, or tags. It also supports custom background, overflow effects, gradients, and custom selection toolbars and handles.
use_when: You need inline images inside your text (e.g. emojis or badges).
You require custom text overflow handling or positions like before, middle, or after.
You want custom background or gradients applied to specific spans of text.
avoid_when: Standard Flutter Text and RichText widgets already fully cover your project requirements.
strengths: Enables quick construction of rich text based on text formats and special text spans.
Supports copying the actual value of special text instead of widget placeholder values.
Provides custom text overflow widget and control over overflow positions.
weaknesses: Third-party extension library that relies on keeping up with upstream Flutter changes.
Requires writing custom builders for specialized text types.
data.setup_notes: Add extended_text to your pubspec.yaml dependencies.
